AboveSix.Name: Allow dice results to be modified above 6
AboveSix.Hint: Off: Full Blast raises no die above 6, so a natural 6 stays 6. On: a natural 6 becomes 7.

ModifiedCriticals.Name: Count modified dice towards criticals
ModifiedCriticals.Hint: Off: only natural 6s count toward a critical. On: a die Full Blast raises to 6 or more also counts, so a natural 5 counts.

RequireGasPiston.Name: Require the Adjustable Gas Piston for Full Blast
RequireGasPiston.Hint: Off: every Autofire weapon can Full Blast. On: only a weapon with the Adjustable Gas Piston installed can; others fire standard Autofire. The piston is in the Autofire Homebrew Items compendium.
